name: oneworld-rtw-planner-ui
description: Build step for the generated files in web/: app.css, map.js, and the WebAssembly pair (rtw.pvm and vendor/swipl-bundle-no-data.js) that runs the Prolog validator in the browser. All four are committed; nothing needs npm at runtime.

scripts.build: npm run css && npm run map && npm run wasm
scripts.map: esbuild web/map.src.js --bundle --minify --format=iife --global-name=RTWMap --legal-comments=eof --banner:js="/*! Bundles d3-geo and topojson-client (ISC, Copyright Mike Bostock) and Natural Earth land data via world-atlas (ISC). Source and rationale: web/map.src.js */" --outfile=web/map.js --log-level=warning
